ai_rubric.Constructing Stem-and-Leaf Diagrams: Draws a correct back-to-back stem-and-leaf diagram with stems 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, correct ordered leaves on LHS for A and RHS for B, and an accurate key identifying both companies and units.

teacher_walkthrough: We are asked to represent the annual salaries (in thousands of dollars) of 11 employees from Company A and 11 employees from Company B on a back-to-back stem-and-leaf diagram.

Step 1: Determine the stems.
The smallest value across both sets is 26 (in B) and the largest is 64 (in A).
Using the tens digit as the stem gives stems: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

Step 2: Order the data for Company A:
Stem 2: none
Stem 3: 30, 32, 35 $\implies$ leaves 0, 2, 5
Stem 4: 41, 41, 42, 47, 49 $\implies$ leaves 1, 1, 2, 7, 9
Stem 5: 52, 53 $\implies$ leaves 2, 3
Stem 6: 64 $\implies$ leaf 4
Since Company A is on the left-hand side, leaves must increase outwards (from right to left, moving away from the central stem):
Stem 3: $5 \; 2 \; 0$
Stem 4: $9 \; 7 \; 2 \; 1 \; 1$
Stem 5: $3 \; 2$
Stem 6: $4$

Step 3: Order the data for Company B:
Stem 2: 26 $\implies$ leaf 6
Stem 3: 30, 31, 35, 38 $\implies$ leaves 0, 1, 5, 8
Stem 4: 41, 42, 42, 47, 49 $\implies$ leaves 1, 2, 2, 7, 9
Stem 5: 52 $\implies$ leaf 2
Stem 6: none
Since Company B is on the right-hand side, leaves increase normally from left to right.

Step 4: Write a complete key:
$$\text{Key: } 1 \mid 4 \mid 2 \text{ means } \$41\,000 \text{ for Company A and } \$42\,000 \text{ for Company B}$$

hints: Company A has $n = 11$ employee salaries. Find the position of the median: $\frac{11 + 1}{2} = 6\text{th}$ value.
Read the 6th ordered value from the diagram for Company A: 42, which represents $\$42\,000$.
Find the lower quartile $Q_1$ (3rd value $= 35$) and upper quartile $Q_3$ (9th value $= 52$).
Calculate the interquartile range using $\text{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 52 - 35$.
walkthrough:
Find the median salary for Company A ($n = 11$):
$$\text{Position of median} = \dfrac{11 + 1}{2} = 6\text{th value}$$
$$\text{Median} = 42\text{ thousand dollars} = \$42\,000$$

Find the lower quartile $Q_1$ and upper quartile $Q_3$:
$$Q_1 = 3\text{rd value} = 35\text{ thousand dollars} = \$35\,000$$
$$Q_3 = 9\text{th value} = 52\text{ thousand dollars} = \$52\,000$$

Calculate the interquartile range:
$$\text{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 52 - 35 = 17\text{ thousand dollars} = \$17\,000$$

ai_rubric.Finding Medians and Quartiles: Identifies the 6th value as median = $42000, lower quartile as $35000, and upper quartile as $52000.

teacher_walkthrough: We need to find the median and interquartile range of the salaries of the 11 employees in Company A.

Step 1: Write the 11 salaries of Company A in increasing order (in thousands of dollars):
$$30, \; 32, \; 35, \; 41, \; 41, \; 42, \; 47, \; 49, \; 52, \; 53, \; 64$$

Step 2: Find the median ($Q_2$):
With $n = 11$, the median is at position:
$$\text{Position} = \frac{11 + 1}{2} = 6\text{th value}$$
The 6th value is $42$, which corresponds to $\$42\,000$.

Step 3: Find the lower quartile ($Q_1$) and upper quartile ($Q_3$):
The lower half has 5 values below the median: $30, 32, 35, 41, 41$.
The middle value of this lower group is the 3rd value overall:
$$Q_1 = 35 \implies \$35\,000$$
The upper half has 5 values above the median: $47, 49, 52, 53, 64$.
The middle value of this upper group is the 9th value overall:
$$Q_3 = 52 \implies \$52\,000$$

Step 4: Compute the interquartile range (IQR):
$$\text{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 52 - 35 = 17 \implies \$17\,000$$

skill_tags: Calculating a Mean from Raw Data

hints: Calculate the total salary of the existing 11 employees in Company B by summing their 11 values.
Calculate the new total salary for all 12 employees using $\text{New Total} = 12 \times 38.5$ thousand dollars.
Subtract the existing total from the new total to find the salary of the new employee.
walkthrough:
Calculate the sum of the salaries of the 11 existing employees in Company B (in thousands):
$$\sum x = 26 + 30 + 31 + 35 + 38 + 41 + 42 + 42 + 47 + 49 + 52 = 433\text{ (i.e. } \$433\,000)$$

Calculate the new total salary for the 12 employees with mean $\$38.5$ thousand:
$$\text{New total} = 12 \times 38.5 = 462\text{ (i.e. } \$462\,000)$$

Find the salary of the new employee by subtraction:
$$\text{New employee salary} = 462 - 433 = 29\text{ thousand dollars} = \$29\,000$$

ai_rubric.Calculating a Mean from Raw Data: Calculates existing total = $433000, new total = 12 * $38500 = $462000, and subtracts to find new salary = $29000.

teacher_walkthrough: A new employee joins Company B, raising the workforce from 11 to 12 employees. The new mean salary is $\$38\,500$.

Step 1: Calculate the total of the current 11 salaries in Company B.
Sum all 11 salary values from the stem-and-leaf diagram (in thousands of dollars):
$$26 + 30 + 31 + 35 + 38 + 41 + 42 + 42 + 47 + 49 + 52 = 433$$
So the current total salary bill is $\$433\,000$.

Step 2: Calculate the new total salary bill for 12 employees.
Using the definition of the mean, $\bar{x} = \frac{\sum x}{n} \implies \sum x = n \bar{x}$:
$$\text{New total} = 12 \times 38.5 = 462 \text{ thousand dollars} = \$462\,000$$

Step 3: Find the salary of the new employee.
Subtract the old total from the new total:
$$\text{Salary of new employee} = 462 - 433 = 29 \text{ thousand dollars} = \$29\,000$$
